title_en: Several Interim Provisions on the Use and Management of Military-Civilian Joint Airports

articles.content_en: Article 9 Any new civil-military joint-use airport shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the document Guo Ban Fa [1985] No. 49.
Article 10 These Provisions shall be interpreted by the General Staff Department and the State Economic Commission.
Article 11 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
